text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening calls as of 0855 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.40 to C$0.90 lower. Current strength in Canadian dollar seen limiting export opportunities. Hedge related selling may weigh on new crop. Canada's dollar was stronger at C$1.3771 versus the U.S. dollar but fell against the yen to 91.20.

FLAXSEED - steady to C$0.30 lower. Market should remain on the defensive after setting new contract lows Monday. Both export and domestic demand appears very sluggish. May also be spillover weakness from canola.

WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 lower weakened by easier CBOT grain calls. Main feature likely to be continued May/July spread trade at around even money with both longs and shorts rolling out of the spot contract.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 lower on easier CBOT grain calls. Fairly active May/July spread trade anticipated.
PEAS - US$0.50 lower on weakness in other markets.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
